description.text: Basic Requirements Applicants should be under 50 years old, undergraduates with bachelor degree, healthy, non-criminal record. Language Requirements For English-taught programs: from an English-speaking country, or IELTS score reaches 6.5 or TOEFL score reaches 80 (or equivalence). For Chinese-taught programs: at least new HSK level 6 or equivalence

duration.text: The Clinical Discipline of Chinese and Western Integrative Medicine at Zhengzhou University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5555 USD/per year ￥ 40000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 7.Study plan Explaining your studies, work experiences and research plan. You should also give information of any academic publications or other scholarly achievements you believe may be relevant.(no less than 1000 words, in English or Chinese) 8.Financial support statement Photocopy of the financial support statement with signature 9. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 10.Certification of no criminal record Original copy of notarized copy in Chinese or English. 11.Internship Certificate (for medical programs) Original copy of notarized copy in Chinese or English.

requirements.text: Be good in condition. Come from the English-speaking countries, or IELTS score reaches 6.0 or TOEFL score reaches 530
